<style>
  :root {
      --dark: #303030;
      --light: #dadada;
  }

  .text-field-tts {
      width: 100%;
      background-color: var(--light);
      border-radius: 5px;
      padding: 7px 12px 7px 12px;
  }

  .voice-select-tts {
      width: 100%;
      height: 7em;
      color: var(--light);
      background-color: var(--dark);
      border-radius: 5px;
  }

  .button-tts {
      border: none;
      border-radius: 5px;
      padding: 7px 12px 7px 12px;
      font-size: 12pt;
      cursor: pointer;
      margin: 10px 6px 10px 0px;
  }

  .button-tts-misc {
      border: none;
      border-radius: 5px;
      padding: 7px 12px 7px 12px;
      font-size: 12pt;
      cursor: pointer;
      margin: 10px 6px 10px 0px;
      color: var(--dark);
      background-color: var(--light);
  }

  .button-tts-misc:hover {
      background-color: #b1b1b1;
  }

  .button-tts-misc:active {
      background-color: #7e7e7e;
  }

  #button-tts-main {
      color: var(--light);
      background-color: #2654d3;
  }

  #button-tts-main:hover {
      background-color: #1e43a8;
  }

  #button-tts-main:active {
      background-color: #152e72;
  }
</style>

Put any text into the field below, choose a voice, and press "Speak".

<button type="button" class="button-tts" id="button-tts-main">Speak</button>
<button type="button" class="button-tts-misc" id="button-tts-stop">Stop</button>
<button type="button" class="button-tts-misc" id="button-tts-delete">Delete</button>

<textarea class="text-field-tts" rows="10" placeholder="Paste text here!"></textarea>
Select a voice:
<select class="voice-select-tts" size="3"></select>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const synthesis = window.speechSynthesis;
  const speakerSelect = document.querySelector(".voice-select-tts");
  const inputField = document.querySelector(".text-field-tts");
  const btnSpeak = document.querySelector("#button-tts-main");
  const btnStop = document.querySelector("#button-tts-stop");
  const btnDelete = document.querySelector("#button-tts-delete");
  let speakersArray = [];

  // Filter languages preferred by me personally by default
  function filterMyLanguages(voice) {
    return voice.lang === "cs-CZ" || voice.lang === "en-US";
  }

  function loadSpeakers() {
    if (!speakerSelect) return;

    speakerSelect.innerHTML = "";

    const allVoices = synthesis.getVoices();
    speakersArray = allVoices.filter(filterMyLanguages);

    // In case of no speech modules present on the device
    if (speakersArray.length === 0) {
      const noVoicesOption = document.createElement("option");
      noVoicesOption.textContent = "No voices found on this device";
      noVoicesOption.disabled = true;
      noVoicesOption.selected = true;
      speakerSelect.appendChild(noVoicesOption);
      return;
    }

    // Fill up voice select element
    speakersArray.forEach((voice, index) => {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.textContent = `${voice.lang}: ${voice.name}`;
      option.value = index;
      speakerSelect.appendChild(option);
    });

    // Select topmost voice by default
    speakerSelect.selectedIndex = 0;
  }

  function speakText() {
    if (!inputField || !inputField.value.trim()) {
      console.warn("The text field is empty.");
      return;
    }

    // Prevent queues
    synthesis.cancel();

    const sayThis = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(inputField.value);
    const selectedIndex = speakerSelect.selectedIndex;
    if (selectedIndex >= 0 && speakersArray[selectedIndex]) {
      sayThis.voice = speakersArray[selectedIndex];
    }

    synthesis.speak(sayThis);
  }

  function stopSpeech() {
    synthesis.cancel();
  }

  function deleteText() {
    if (inputField) {
      inputField.value = "";
      inputField.focus();
    }
  }

  // Load voices in possibly all browser engines
  function initializeVoices() {
    loadSpeakers();
    if ("onvoiceschanged" in synthesis) {
      synthesis.onvoiceschanged = loadSpeakers;
    } else {
      setTimeout(loadSpeakers, 2000);
    }
  }

  initializeVoices();
  if (btnSpeak) btnSpeak.addEventListener("click", speakText);
  if (btnStop) btnStop.addEventListener("click", stopSpeech);
  if (btnDelete) btnDelete.addEventListener("click", deleteText);
})();
</script>

Works best on Firefox.

Please note that some browsers contain "online" voices and using these may result in your text not being processed locally.
